answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake before it can influence reputation or claim rewards. Votes are weighted by stake, while penalties slash deposits when an agent is proven to have double-voted or colluded, using auditable signed actions as evidence. A sybil can still create many identities, but each needs fresh capital locked at risk; splitting one deposit among vine, jade, and ferrous personas does not multiply its voting weight, and attacks risk losing the stake.
